_experiment.description: OBS baseline: full-Hessian-inverse saliency w_q²/(2·H_inv_qq) with closed-form weight update δw=-(w_q/H_inv_qq)·H_inv[:,q]. No gradient-descent adjust. do_adjust is false and ignored by the module. Run via: python -m sparsifier.obs_sparsifier experiments/e14_obs.json
literature: Hassibi & Stork 1993 (hassibi1993second): Optimal Brain Surgeon — full-Hessian-inverse saliency with closed-form weight correction
